export_subtitle: Select exposed resources to include in the signed .persona bundle.
team_publish_hint: Anyone can adopt this team blueprint in Personas. No credentials are included.
team_publish_failed: Couldn't publish this team to the catalog

share_link_copied_one: Share link copied! {count} resource (expires in 24h, single use)
share_link_copied_other: Share link copied! {count} resources (expires in 24h, single use)
enclave_info: Enclaves are cryptographically sealed and signed with your identity. The recipient can verify authenticity but cannot modify the persona or extract credentials.
label_allow_persistence: Allow enclave to persist data on host
import_subtitle: Import a signed .persona bundle from a trusted peer.
verify_enclave_subtitle: Verify a sealed persona enclave from a trusted creator.
share_link_placeholder: Paste share link or personas:// URL...
import_pick_hint: Choose a file, paste clipboard data, or use a share link (personas:// deep link) from another Personas instance.
danger_trusted_title: Signature does not match the trusted key for this peer.
danger_trusted_body: The bundle claims to be from a known peer but the signature verification failed. This could indicate tampering. Only proceed if you are certain the source is safe.
danger_trusted_confirm: I understand the risks and want to import this bundle
danger_unknown_title: This bundle is from an unknown signer and cannot be verified.
danger_unknown_body: The signer is not in your trusted peers list, so the signature cannot be checked against a known key. Add the sender as a trusted peer first, or proceed only if you fully trust the source.
danger_unknown_confirm: I understand the risks and want to import this unverified bundle
network_sharing_subtitle: Manage your identity, trusted peers, and shared resources
no_resources_hint: No resources exposed yet. Expose personas or other resources to include them in bundles for sharing.
paste_card_placeholder: Paste the base64 identity card here...
no_trusted_peers: No trusted peers yet. Share your identity card with others to get started.
scope_none_desc: This persona does not require external network access.
scope_restricted_desc: This persona accesses specific external services.
scope_unrestricted_desc: This persona may access any external endpoint.
no_shared_resources: No shared resources. Sync the manifest to check.
lan_hint: Other Personas instances on the same LAN will appear here automatically.
identity_degraded_hint: Your device's signing key couldn't be loaded — the OS keyring may have been reset. Peer trust and sync are broken until you re-initialize your identity.
share_link_tooltip: Generate a one-time share link (expires in 24h)
copy_clipboard_tooltip: Copy bundle as base64 to clipboard (max 256 KB)
devices_subtitle: Link your own machines so they can recognise each other
devices_unavailable_body: This build was compiled without peer-to-peer support, so devices cannot discover or pair with each other. Install the full build to enable linking.
paired_devices_empty_hint: Pick a device below to start linking. Both screens will show the same code.
home_device_hint: Exactly one device can be home. Choosing a new one moves the role away from the current home device.
home_change_failed: Could not change the home device
nearby_hint: Devices running Personas on this network that are not linked yet
nearby_empty_hint: Open Personas on your other machine and keep both on the same network.
pairing_code_body: Check that {device} shows these same six digits, then confirm on that device.
incoming_body: Confirm only if the code below matches the one on the other screen.
refusal_group_conflict: Both devices already belong to different device groups.
refusal_group_conflict_fix: Unpair the conflicting devices on one side first, then try again.
refusal_not_connected: There is no authenticated connection to that device.
refusal_not_connected_fix: Make sure both machines are awake on the same network, then retry.
refusal_self_pair: A device cannot be paired with itself.
refusal_self_pair_fix: Pick a different device from the list.
refusal_declined: The other device declined the request.
refusal_declined_fix: Ask the person at that machine to accept, then try again.
refusal_too_many_pending: The other device is already holding too many pairing requests.
refusal_too_many_pending_fix: Clear the pending requests on that device, then retry.
refusal_timed_out: The request expired before the other device answered.
refusal_timed_out_fix: Start the pairing again with both screens in front of you.
refusal_no_longer_pending: That pairing is no longer in progress.
refusal_no_longer_pending_fix: It expired or was cancelled. Start a new pairing.
refusal_wrong_side: Only the receiving device can confirm a pairing.
refusal_wrong_side_fix: Confirm the code on the other device instead.
refusal_unauthorized: The session is not authorised for this action.
refusal_unauthorized_fix: Unlock the app and try again.
refusal_unavailable: Device linking is unavailable in this build.
refusal_unavailable_fix: Install the full build to enable peer-to-peer features.
refusal_unknown_fix: The details below come from the other device.
peer_connect_failed_toast: Could not connect to the peer
peer_disconnect_failed_toast: Could not disconnect from the peer
remote_jobs_subtitle: Work you asked another device to do, and work another device asked of this one.
remote_jobs_empty_hint: Once you ask a paired device to do something, every exchange is recorded here.
job_notes_empty: No progress notes arrived for this instruction.
job_notes_failed: Could not load the progress notes.
job_summary_pending: Waiting for the device to finish.
send_instruction_hint: Pick a paired device and say what it should do. Its Athena runs it as a real turn and reports back here.
send_instruction_placeholder: For example: summarise the build failures from today
send_instruction_no_devices: Pair a device first, then you can send it work.
remote_notice_failed: The errand for {device} did not finish
